game.name: Rainroot Relay
game.description: Rotate root-channel tiles to carry precious rainwater across a rooftop garden and revive the waiting flower.

generation.author: Prompt 2 Play Bot
generation.prompt: Create a self-contained, mobile-friendly browser puzzle game named Rainroot Relay using only semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript with no external dependencies. Present a warm paper-cut rooftop garden during a rain shower. The player must rotate a compact grid of root-channel tiles to connect a rain barrel on the left edge to a wilted flower on the right edge, then test the route by releasing a visible water pulse. Generate a guaranteed-solvable board by building one connected route and scrambling tile rotations, include decorative decoy channels, and provide three progressively larger rounds. Each round has a limited rotation budget; an incomplete tested route or exhausted budget ends the run, while completing all three rounds wins. Support pointer and touch by tapping tiles and buttons, plus keyboard play with arrow-key tile selection, Space to rotate, and Enter to release water. Clearly show the selected tile, remaining turns, round progress, concise in-game instructions, a start state, active gameplay, animated success or leak feedback, a loss state, a completion state, and a replay path. Make the layout responsive down to a mobile viewport, use accessible labels and focus styles, respect reduced-motion preferences, and create all visuals with CSS and inline browser-native graphics. Also add a lightweight 16:9 SVG preview that matches the game's paper-cut rain garden theme.
